title: Account Executive, Traffic Engineering (Nordics, UK, Netherlands)
descriptionHtml:
About Miovision:

At Miovision, we’re unlocking transportation networks that move you. Our vision and mission is to enable smart, fast, safe communities that simply flow, as we drive the Intelligent Mobility Revolution. Backed by the world’s most advanced traffic AI, Miovision’s innovations in traffic signal planning and operations are making it possible for cities to improve the transportation experience for drivers, cyclists and pedestrians.

Our values drive us. They’re at the core of everything we do. If they align with yours, proceed through the GREEN light!

  • All in to win: We're driven by a winning mindset, approaching every challenge with intensity, clarity, and speed.

  • One Miovision: We succeed as one team, uniting diverse talents, building on trust, and putting our shared mission before ego.

  • Be better every day: We're committed to continuous growth, staying curious, building mastery, and embracing challenges as learning opportunities.

  • Make it happen: We are proactive and results-driven, taking ownership, acting with urgency, and focusing on solutions that deliver real impact.

  • Earn the customer: We are deeply customer-centric, focused on earning our customers' partnership every day by delivering exceptional experiences that drive their success.

Position Summary:

Cities are living, breathing organisms, and right now, many of them are stuck in gridlock. As an Account Executive at Miovision, you are the primary driver of the "green light." Your mission is to help municipalities trade traffic frustrations for smart, fluid urban environments that simply flow. You aren't just selling tech; you are clearing the path for safer intersections and steering initiatives that directly reduce congestion.

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying, qualifying, and closing new business opportunities within a defined territory. You will act as the primary point of contact for municipal stakeholders, driving the adoption of Miovision's Traffic Engineering products (hardware and software) by aligning our solutions with their specific infrastructure goals.

Territory Coverage: Nordics (Finland, Norway, Sweden, Denmark), UK, and Netherlands

Objectives and Responsibilities:

  • Deliver Results: Achieve or exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets by prioritizing high-value prospects within a defined territory.

  • Own the Sales Lifecycle: Independently manage the end-to-end sales process, from discovery and needs analysis to contract negotiation and closing.

  • Build your Pipeline: Make prospecting part of your regular routine.

  • Strategic Forecasting and Growth: Develop and execute territory plans that maintain a robust, multi-stage pipeline of opportunities.

  • Product Champion: Champion our full suite of solutions, including Traffic Planning, Traffic Operations, Emergency Vehicle Preemption, Transit Signal Priority, and any other solutions available to market in the territory.

  • Consult with Purpose: Act as a trusted advisor to city departments to uncover their needs and articulate the value of Miovision's solutions.

  • Strategic Opportunity Management: Lead the coordination and development of RFP and RFI responses to position Miovision as the preferred vendor for modern traffic solutions.

  • Maintain Data Integrity: Use Salesforce with discipline to provide leadership with accurate forecasts and clear visibility into your pipeline.

  • Industry Trends: Stay sharp on market challenges and the competitive landscape to effectively position Miovision’s value proposition.

  • Ecosystem Collaboration: Work collaboratively with Partners, Business Development and Marketing teams to launch regional campaigns. Engage an array of external influencers such as City Departments, City Mobility, Open Data, Engineering Firms, Academics, Consultants, etc.

  • Brand Ambassador: Represent Miovision in person on site with clients and at major trade shows. Travel up to 30%.

Ideal Profile:

  • Specialized Sales Knowledge: Proven experience selling technology to public and private sector (B2B and B2G). You understand consultative selling methodologies, and how to navigate long cycles and public procurement processes (RFPs).

  • Domain Expertise: Understanding of the Mobility, ITS, or Traffic Engineering landscape is a strong asset.

  • Territory Knowledge: Prior experience working with customers in the Nordics is strongly desired.

  • Strategic Acumen: You don't just wait for leads; you build territory plans and maintain a robust, multi-stage pipeline of opportunities (Salesforce or similar CRM proficiency is a must).

  • Hybrid Technology Fluency: Equally comfortable navigating the nuances of software systems and hardware-integrated traffic solutions and you can effectively communicate the value of both.

  • "Hunter" Mindset: You thrive on finding new business and have a proven track record of navigating multi-dimensional, complex sales environments.

  • Influence and Negotiation: Advanced negotiation and presentation skills, with the ability to influence mid-to-senior level municipal stakeholders.

  • Self-driven: You are highly self-motivated and comfortable operating autonomously in a fast-paced, evolving industry.

  • The Networker: You excel at creating external visibility and fostering internal collaboration.

  • Travel: You’re ready to get out into the field, meet customers, and represent us at major trade shows (up to 30%).

  • Language Skills: Fluent English and at least one other Nordic language is preferred.

This is a remote opportunity for candidates located in France (La France) or the Netherlands (Nederlands).

FR: En tant qu’Account Executive chez Miovision, votre mission consiste à accompagner les collectivités territoriales pour transformer les frustrations liées au trafic en environnements urbains intelligents où la circulation est fluide. Vous êtes responsable de l'identification, de la qualification et de l'acquisition de nouvelles opportunités au sein de votre région. Véritable interlocuteur privilégié des décideurs publics, vous stimulez l'adoption des solutions matérielles et logicielles de Miovision en les alignant parfaitement sur leurs objectifs d'infrastructure spécifiques.

NL: Als Account Executive bij Miovision is het jouw missie om gemeenten te helpen verkeersfrustraties om te zetten in slimme stedelijke omgevingen waar het verkeer vloeiend doorstroomt. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het identificeren, kwalificeren en verzilveren van nieuwe kansen binnen jouw regio. Je fungeert als het centrale aanspreekpunt voor gemeentelijke belanghebbenden en stimuleert de adoptie van de hardware- en softwareoplossingen van Miovision door deze naadloos af te stemmen op hun specifieke infrastructuurdoelstellingen.

Trefwoorden / Keywords:

  • Smart Mobility / Slimme Mobiliteit / Mobilité Intelligente / Mobilité et Transport

  • Intelligent Transportation Systems / Intelligente Transportsystemen / ITS / Les systèmes de transport intelligents (STI)

  • Smart Cities / Slimme Steden / Ville Intelligente / Route intelligente

  • Traffic Studies & Analytics / Verkeersonderzoek / Études de trafic

  • Traffic Management / Verkeersmanagement / Gestion du trafic

  • Business Development & Sales / Ventes B2B

  • Public Sector / Municipalities / Overheid & Gemeenten / Secteur Public & Collectivités Territoriales

Your Rewards & Well-being:
We invest in our team with benefits designed for modern life and true work-life balance.

  • Comprehensive Coverage: Your well-being is covered from day one with comprehensive health benefits, 24/7 virtual healthcare access, and dedicated wellness programs.

  • Financial Future: Build for tomorrow with our RRSP/401K Matching Plan and share in the company's success through our Variable Incentive Plan.

  • Time to Recharge: Truly unplug with our unique Mio-Days and flexible vacation policy.

  • Work & Life Support: We support you with flexible work options, an internet subsidy, a remote work allowance, and enhanced leave for new parents.

Sound like your next adventure? Apply now and let's start building together!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Please indicate if you require accommodation on your application, and our team will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

Miovision may use artificial intelligence (AI) to assist in the hiring process for tasks such as helping to identify qualified candidates, taking meeting notes, creating summaries, and streamlining administrative work. These tools are one of several factors considered in the hiring process and do not replace human judgement. We do not use AI to make any final hiring or interview decisions.

PLEASE BE AWARE OF FRAUD: Applicants interested in applying for roles at Miovision should apply directly via the details provided on our careers page. We communicate directly with applicants and will not request banking information, payment, or fees during any point of the recruitment process. We do not conduct interviews via text message. If you suspect that a third party is impersonating Miovision or requesting payment for recruitment on behalf of Miovision, please alert us via recruitment@miovision.com.

To all recruitment agencies: Miovision does not accept agency solicitation or resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our HR alias e-mail address, to any Miovision employee, or to other Miovision e-mail addresses. Miovision will not pay any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
